Description:
The Metrocentre is probably the last place you’d expect to find one of the North East’s loveliest rooftop terraces, but just a stone’s throw away, hidden inside a furniture shop, is one of the region’s most unexpected breakfast spots. 

This is Chadwick & Co, a coffee house and kitchen hidden on a third floor mezzanine inside Barker & Stonehouse.   

The space is stunning with exposed brick, statement lighting, huge ceilings and plenty of seating.

But the real highlight has to be the outdoor terrace.  A beautiful suntrap that honestly feels a million miles away from Gateshead. 

And then there’s the food!  Specailising in Greek and Levantine flavours inspired by travels around the Mediterranean, the dishes are created using locally sourced ingredients and their breakfast menu really is something special.  

I went for the Greek Brioche Toast and it was unlike any French Toast I have ever had before, made using traditional sweet Greek brioche, it comes served with Greek Yoghurt, Fruit Compote, Almonds, Honey and Cinnamon and if holidays made breakfast, this would be it!  It was absolutely stunning! 

Rest assured I am now very much looking forward to working my way through the whole menu.

This rooftop breakfast spot really is hiding in plain sight and it’s well worth adding to your list.

📍 You’ll find Chadwick & Co at Barker & Stonehouse, Metro Park West, Gibside Way, Gateshead, NE11 9XS

⏰ Open Monday-Saturday: 10:00 – 16:00
and Sunday: 11am –16:00

One of our most frequently asked questions is: “Which dining chairs go with which tables?”

So we’re here to help! Starting with one of our favourite styles: statement, sculptural dining tables.

When choosing chairs to pair with this type of table, look for designs that complement the table’s bold form. Try:

✨ Clean lines & metallic details
✨ Modern shapes & playful colours
✨ Organic curves & tactile textures

The key is to balance strong silhouettes with materials and finishes that add warmth, contrast and personality.
